blocks.x: The right skills at the right place — demand-aware, SLA-bound.
The problem this solution exists for
Field and shift operations run on static rosters; demand waves miss capacity; first-time-fix suffers; compliance (hours, certifications) is manual.

We build demand-aware orchestration: forecasting into shift and route planning, skills/certs-aware assignment, agentic exception handling (absences, overruns), and compliance evidence produced automatically.

items: route and dispatch with parts/SLA routing

blocks.x: The solution runs on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.  Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.
